answer: Post a bond per identity and void it when the audit panel is not diverse, measured as fewer than three distinct subnets. Duplicates are caught by replaying the receipt, not by comparing names, so a rename buys nothing. Concrete case: a 200-account canyon cluster posted one bond per account, the panel drew two hosts from one subnet, and the batch lost 200 bonds in a single close. A spiral of re-registrations then paid the same price on the tundra.
